#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

long long powMod(long long a, long long b) {
    long long ans = 1, d = a % MOD;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) ans = ans * d % MOD;
        d = d * d % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    const int MAX = 200001;
    vector<long long> fac(MAX), inv(MAX);
    fac[0] = inv[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < MAX; i++) {
        fac[i] = fac[i-1] * i % MOD;
        inv[i] = inv[i-1] * powMod(i, MOD-2) % MOD;
    }
    
    int n;
    long long k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    
    if (k >= n) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fac[n] << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    
    int m = n - k;
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
        long long term = fac[m] * inv[i] % MOD * inv[m-i] % MOD;
        term = term * powMod(m - i, n) % MOD;
        if (i % 2 == 0) {
            ans = (ans + term) % MOD;
        } else {
            ans = (ans - term) % MOD;
            if (ans < 0) ans += MOD;
        }
    }
    
    long long result = 2LL * fac[n] % MOD * inv[n - m] % MOD * ans % MOD * inv[m] % MOD;
    cout << result << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
